source.title: Building setbacks rules in Conroe TX (third-party summary: Ch. 94 subdivision, Ch. 14 building, Ch. 102 trees)

plainLanguage: Conroe has no zoning ordinance, so there are no city zoning districts. Your setbacks come from the building lines on your subdivision plat and from deed or HOA restrictions. Have these ready. Conroe is not in the state windstorm area. In a mapped floodplain, the finished floor must be at least 12 inches above the 100-year flood level. Conroe does not charge water, sewer or road impact fees today. A study is under way and fees could be adopted around late 2027. We could not confirm the city's current code editions (likely 2021 IRC and NEC 2023) or its permit fee; ask the Building Department.
